questions.question: Many students choose online learning _____ it offers greater flexibility.
questions.explanation_cn: 前后是因果关系，因此使用 because。
questions.explanation_en: 'Because' introduces the reason for choosing online learning.

questions.question: _____ technology has improved communication, it has also created new privacy concerns.
questions.explanation_cn: 前后表示让步关系，应使用 although。
questions.explanation_en: 'Although' introduces a contrast between two ideas.

questions.question: The researchers repeated the experiment _____ they could verify the results.
questions.explanation_cn: so that 表示目的，意为'为了……'。

questions.question: _____ the evidence was limited, the researchers drew cautious conclusions.
questions.explanation_cn: while 可表示'虽然、尽管'，常用于学术英语表示让步。
questions.explanation_en: 'While' can introduce a concession, meaning 'although' in formal English.

questions.question: The data were analysed carefully _____ the researchers could identify reliable patterns.
questions.explanation_cn: 分析数据的目的，是为了识别可靠的规律，因此使用 so that。
questions.explanation_en: 'So that' expresses the purpose of analysing the data.

questions.question: _____ many countries have reduced carbon emissions, global temperatures continue to rise.
questions.explanation_cn: 前后存在明显转折关系，因此使用 although。
questions.explanation_en: 'Although' correctly introduces a contrast between the two clauses.

questions.question: _____ the limited budget, the research team completed the project successfully.
questions.explanation_cn: despite 后接名词或名词短语；although 后接完整句子。这是 IELTS/PTE 高频考点。
questions.explanation_en: 'Despite' is followed by a noun phrase, whereas 'although' introduces a clause.

questions.question: The university will offer you a place _____ you meet all the admission requirements.
questions.explanation_cn: provided that 表示'只要、如果'，常用于正式英语和合同、学校规定。
questions.explanation_en: 'Provided that' means 'if' or 'on the condition that' in formal English.

questions.question: The two studies reached different conclusions, _____ both examined the same issue.
questions.explanation_cn: whereas 用于比较和对比，是 IELTS 阅读和写作中的高频连接词。
questions.explanation_en: 'Whereas' introduces a contrast between two related ideas.

questions.question: No sooner _____ the presentation than the audience began asking challenging questions.
questions.explanation_cn: 固定倒装结构：No sooner had + 主语 + 过去分词 + than...，属于 IELTS 7.5+、PTE 高分语法。
questions.explanation_en: 'No sooner...than...' requires inversion: 'No sooner had + subject + past participle...'.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences are grammatically correct?

options.text: Despite the increasing demand, the company decided not to expand production.
Although demand increased, the company decided not to expand production.
Despite demand increased, the company decided not to expand production.
The policy will remain effective provided that all participants follow the regulations.

questions.explanation_cn: A：正确，despite 后接名词短语。B：正确，although 后接完整句子。C：错误，despite 后不能接完整句子。D：正确，provided that 引导条件状语从句，是正式英语中的高频表达。
questions.explanation_en: A correctly uses 'despite' with a noun phrase. B correctly uses 'although' with a clause. C is incorrect because 'despite' cannot be followed directly by a clause. D correctly uses 'provided that' to express a condition.
